internet.subtitle: This device needs to reach Tag Hunter to sign you in.
internet.offline: We can’t reach Tag Hunter. Connect this computer to the internet, then try again.

name.title: Name this device
name.subtitle: A friendly name makes this machine easy to recognize on your account and in support.
name.label: Device name

mother.title: Default game server?
mother.subtitle: Use this computer as the default game server (the “mother”) that runs your games on the local network.
mother.yes: Yes, use this computer as the game server

operatorOnly.title: Operator-only device?
operatorOnly.subtitle: Use this computer only to manage and launch games, never to play them.
operatorOnly.yes: Yes, this is an operator-only device
operatorOnly.no: No, games will also be played on this device
operatorOnly.explainer: Turn this on when this computer will never be played on - only used to set up and launch games for other devices. It then downloads only each game's data and cover image (not the full media or tutorial videos), saving disk space, and doesn't need a card reader or its driver.

appearance.subtitle: Pick the look of the app. You can change it later in Settings.
